alert_summary.trigger: Blood glucose reading of 210 mg/dL detected by Dexcom G6 CGM, exceeding threshold of 180 mg/dL

clinical_brief.contextual_analysis: The patient has a history of Type 2 Diabetes and obesity, with previously well-controlled glucose levels and recent HbA1c of 7.4% (EHR). The current glucose elevation coincides with the start of a planned high-carbohydrate diet trial under nutritionist supervision, begun 3 days prior (Anamnesis). The patient is adherent to both Metformin and Empagliflozin, and reports no symptoms of hyperglycemia (Anamnesis).
clinical_brief.risk_assessment: This moderate glucose elevation may suggest a transient response to increased carbohydrate intake as part of the dietary trial, rather than medication nonadherence or acute metabolic decompensation. Absence of symptoms and continued medication adherence could indicate low immediate risk, but ongoing monitoring is warranted.

recommended_actions.action: Consider monitoring glucose closely during the dietary trial and reassess in 3-7 days
Suggest patient logs dietary intake and glucose readings for review with care team
Reinforce medication adherence and educate on signs of hyperglycemia

uncertainties_and_gaps: Patient age and gender not available in EHR
No recent formal nutritionist or dietary counseling notes in EHR
No longitudinal glucose trend data available
No current symptoms reported, but symptom review may be incomplete
Recent medication list partially missing in some EHR records
